head: 918614aba21ada7d166ea0b94fa6d34d612e9dfd
title: Pending commit and cancel release the per-transaction lock on success, which lets an unguarded release apply the opposite transition

bugs.anchor: Released on every exit, including an indeterminate engine outcome
bugs.anchor_end: tran, err := uc\.transitionPendingWithEngine\(ctx, span, logger, run, true\)
bugs.note: Before this change a successful commit or cancel kept the Redis lock until its TTL. The change releases it with a deferred call on every exit, on the argument that the engine guard stops a second transition. A release path that does not use the engine guard only takes the same lock, so once the lock is freed it can cancel a hold that was just committed (or commit one just cancelled), and the funds of the hold move twice.
